python_module_invocation.detail: Bare python -m hermes_skilleval.cli is not importable in this checkout; PYTHONPATH=src is required for local CLI execution.

isolated_codex_home.detail: CodexCliRunnerConfig defaults codex_home_mode=isolated and isolate_home=true; runtime sets runner-controlled CODEX_HOME and HOME.

global_capability_inventory_preflight.detail: CodexCliRunner emits global_capability_inventory/skill_inventory in preflight and checks user/admin/workspace skill leakage.

skillsbench_task_source.detail: No real or approved 4-task pilot SkillsBench data root was found. Only tests/fixtures/live_agent/skillsbench_tiny exists, and it contains 2 fixture-only tasks.

deterministic_verifier.detail: No real deterministic verifier integration for selected pilot tasks was found. The current skillsbench-matrix CLI path defaults to FakeVerifier(pass_=true) when no verifier is injected.

oracle_qualification.detail: No real oracle qualification artifact for 4 selected pilot tasks was found. The only oracle_qualification.jsonl discovered is fixture-only and covers 2 fixture tasks.

routed_predictions.detail: No routed-skill prediction artifact connected to 4 real selected pilot tasks was found. The only routed_predictions.json discovered is fixture-only and covers 2 fixture tasks.

real_codex_runner_cli_path.detail: skillsbench-matrix CLI does not expose CodexCliRunner configuration and run_skillsbench_matrix defaults to FakeAgentRunner/FakeVerifier when called through the CLI.
